AboutSection.subtitle: About Vyanzo
AboutSection.description: Founded in 2018, Vyanzo (Which means “new source” in Swahili) manufactures manhole covers, grates, and cast iron parts for local authorities, distributed throughout Europe and internationally. Quality, service, and reliability are not just empty words: they are our commitments

EnvironmentSection.subtitle: Environmental Responsibility
EnvironmentSection.description: Zero coal. Unlike production in for example Belgium, we don’t use coal to melt, but electrical induction furnaces. A giant solar park fuels the electricity. Every facility is built to minimize footprint, not just meet standards, but set them.

ContactSection.subtitle: Your Next Step

hero.subtitle: Company Profile
hero.description: Discover our range of meticulously designed and manufactured products. Vyanzo delivers top-quality castings to the most demanding customers — consistent quality and service level are paramount to what we do.

philosophy.title: Quality, Service & Reliability with relentless consistency.
philosophy.description: Since its inception in 2018, Vyanzo has evolved from an OEM supplier to become a leading manufacturer of its own range of Manhole Covers, Grates and other municipal casting products now supplied across Europe.

service.description: We offer end-to-end services to customers around the world who share our business philosophy: Quality, Service & Reliability at a correct price — and that with relentless consistency. By managing production, quality assurance, and logistics in-house, Vyanzo ensures a seamless experience for its clients.

members.name: Steve Vernelen
bio: Steve Vernelen has been doing business globally for the last 20 years, as CEO of Benito Urban in Spain (manhole covers and grates, urban equipment) and as CEO of Fondatel (foundry of manhole covers) in Belgium.
He holds an MBA from Kellogg School of Management , started his business career at McKinsey & Cie to then move on to turning around troubled private equity held companies.

members.name: Roxane Sabatier
bio: Roxane Sabatier runs our Mumbai office. She is fluent in English, French, Hindi, Italian and Spanish. A journalist by education, she has the tenacity to achieve her goals.
Roxane and Steve have worked together for over a decade in various companies. Roxane joined Vyanzo in 2022.

members.name: Annick D'Hont
bio: Annick D'Hont is a seasoned lawyer and specializes in corporate contract law and logistics, leaving no loose ends. She has been an integral part of Vyanzo since its inception.

members.name: Naba Kumar Gayen
bio: Naba Kumar Gayen is our Head of Quality, based in Kolkata. He inspects production and product development locally at the foundries in India making sure any issues are detected before products get shipped. He is an engineer and has 15+ years of experience in the casting industry. He joined Vyanzo in 2019.
